items.title: BABA Investors Have Opportunity to Lead Alibaba Group Holding Limited Securities Fraud Lawsuit with SBS Law
items.summary: Schall, Brown & Schwartz LLP announces a securities fraud class action lawsuit against Alibaba Group Holding Limited for allegedly making false and misleading statements regarding its control by the Chinese Ministry of Industry and Information and undisclosed AI model distillation activities. The class period spans June 26, 2025 to June 24, 2026, with a deadline of October 5, 2026 for investors to participate.

items.title: ROSEN, A LEADING LAW FIRM, Encourages Alibaba Group Holding Limited Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – BABA
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Alibaba Group Holding Limited on behalf of investors who purchased securities between June 26, 2025 and June 24, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Alibaba made false and misleading statements regarding its control by the Chinese Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT), its classification as a Chinese military company under the NDAA, and undisclosed risks of distillation attacks against third-party AI models. Investors who wish to serve as lead plaintiff must file by October 5, 2026.

items.title: Alibaba Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE: BABA), You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
items.summary: The Rosen Law Firm announced an investigation into potential securities claims against Alibaba Group Holding Limited following allegations that the company issued materially misleading business information. The investigation was triggered by a Financial Times article reporting that Anthropic accused Alibaba of obtaining illicit access to Claude AI through fake accounts. Alibaba's American Depositary Shares fell 2.7% on June 24, 2026, following the news. The firm is preparing a class action lawsuit to recover investor losses.
